CI warnings of the CLIENT and CONNECT publishes. The Connect release no longer downloads a Samsung package, which only CLIENT has. build-browser checks out the asset submodule its UI's project reference names. The Google heads' AndroidX packages agree: Lifecycle.Process 2.11 in GooglePlay.Core, Tracing.Ktx 2.0 in AdMob. The iOS build drops setup-xcode's deprecated MD_APPLE_SDK_ROOT, and the Android SDK step asks for cmdline-tools 19.0, the newest its installer's list has. Silenced: XA1006 and XA4211, as the manifest holds the target at 36 on purpose; AVLN3001, as no view goes through the runtime loader; and the trim analysis on the Apple heads, where only the SDK's assemblies are trimmed, and on the browser page, whose reflection is known.
OpenWolf: session learnings (stash/autostash pitfalls, hostByName lock, ADR README row)

CONNECT on a TV shows the internal ad alone. AdMob has no ads for a TV: on the Android TV emulator Google's own test units answer No fill, so every connect waited on a load that could not succeed, a rewarded ad had no fallback, and AdMob's consent form, never checked by remote, could have opened over the app. Off a TV nothing changes. Checked on the emulator: no AdMob request on a TV, and the internal film plays with the focus on Close, which the remote's centre key takes at the end.

TV: the UI fits the screen at any size. A TV layout is drawn for 960x540, but a TV's own layout size is not that everywhere: tvOS lays out in points, 1920x1080, and an Android TV's size comes from a density its maker chose, so a set could show the UI at half its size (1920x1080 dp), the Apple TV's fault on the owner's 4K TV, or with so few dp that the phone's layout took over and was cut off. TvScreenFit scales the view by the screen's size on every TV, replacing tvOS's fixed 2x; a browser driving a TV stays as it was. Checked on the Android TV emulator at densities 160, 240, 320, 480 and 640, the same picture at each, and on the Apple TV simulator at full size.
